scene: Morning of 1 Nesting 1156 AC, 08:00: Maddoc wakes rested at his family cottage after successful Soul self-awareness practice the previous evening. He meets Hedra beside the homestead shed, where muddy harnesses, buckles and worn straps await sorting and cleaning. Hedra offered 2 Talons for a properly completed morning's work; the job has not yet been performed or paid. Bram and Tessa are to be met later if possible.
summary: After family supper, Maddoc practised Soul self-awareness 129 minutes until 21:00: d20 17+2=19 vs 14, +2 progress (2/100), -2 stamina. Slept 11h; woke 08:00, stamina restored 36/36. Hedra discussed 2 Talons for completed harness-cleaning and sorting work; no work or pay yet.
